# Draft:List of BAFTA Award-winning films

This is a list of films that have won awards at the British Academy Film Awards.
The British Academy Film Awards are presented annually by the British Academy of Film and Television Arts (BAFTA). The awards were first held in 1949 by the British Film Academy, which later merged with the Guild of Television Producers and Directors in 1958 to form BAFTA. They are considered one of the most prestigious film awards in the world.
If a film won the BAFTA Award for Best Film, its entry is listed in a shaded background with a boldface title.
Competitive BAFTA Awards are separated from non-competitive awards (such as special or honorary awards); therefore, any films that received a non-competitive award will have that award indicated in brackets next to the number of competitive wins.
